metadata.description: Four plugins for AI-assisted work in Claude Code and Codex: a daily build loop that stops after every phase, explanations and write-ups, skill building, and GTM engineering on plain files.

plugins.name: aym-skills
plugins.description: A daily build loop: describe the job, and work-my-way runs clarify, plan, build, check and ship one phase at a time, stopping after each.

plugins.name: aym-story
plugins.description: Turn finished work into understanding and stories: plain-English explanations, practice quizzes, blog articles and portfolio cases.

plugins.name: aym-lab
plugins.description: Build and improve agent skills: dissect how a system works, build a skill, pressure-test it, and capture lessons from finished work.

plugins.name: aym-gtm
plugins.description: GTM engineering skills: define the ICP, clean lists and audit the CRM, build the prospect and account books, score buying signals, build plays, plan the day, sync with the CRM through files, review the funnel, map the sales motion, and draft outreach to files. Vendor-neutral, never sends.
